reason: In VerifyMessageProperties.java (patch lines 159-179), normalizeValue removes `CLAIM.<[A-Z]*>` for templateHelp, `<Extensions>` for optimizeLookupHelp, and `{n,choice,...}` blocks for linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit* and error-invalid-multivalued-size. For files under email it also removes ` style="direction: rtl;"`. All of this happens before the value is checked against the OWASP policy, so those parts are never sanitized.
